title: Pick from one belt, place on another
summary: Sequence a clamp carriage with limit sensors and a grip feedback to move four boxes from an infeed belt to an outfeed belt.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Sequence a pick and place so that each move starts only when the previous one is complete.
Lift a box only when the clamp reports that it holds it, and put each box down without disturbing it.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/BeltTransfer.st, write a CASE state machine: for each box lower the clamp, close it on the box, lift, carry the box over the outfeed, lower, open the clamp, lift and return. Do it for four boxes and light Done when the fourth has passed EyeOut.
stages.checkpoint: Every move starts only when the previous one is complete.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, follow one box: the blade holds it at EyePick, the clamp comes down, closes, lifts and crosses to XMax, and the box is put down on the outfeed.
stages.checkpoint: Grip is on from the moment the clamp closes until the box is on the outfeed; Hold stays on during the job.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then press {{ui:learn.check}}: The starter drives no output, so nothing moves; write the transfer: feed one box at a time, grip, carry and release each one over the outfeed, and light Done after the fourth.
stages.checkpoint: {{ui:learn.check}} reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press {{ui:learn.check}}. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press {{ui:toolbar.run.label}} (F5) and open the {{ui:plant.panel.view3d}}.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named belt-to-belt-transfer and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch the clamp in the {{ui:plant.panel.view3d}}: it stays closed and still until the box is held, and the box lies still where it is put down.
stages.checkpoint: No box falls, and the clamp opens only over the outfeed belt.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The scenario proves that the clamp picked a box and put it down, that a box reached the end of the outfeed, that nothing was dropped and that Done is lit at the end. It does not count that exactly four boxes crossed: that count is in your program.
stages.checkpoint: What the assertions check is tested; nothing else is.

hints.text: Look at what tells you that each move is complete: which signal is on when the clamp is down, when the box is held, when the clamp is up, and when it is over the outfeed.

The clamp takes time to close and a box that still moves is not taken: wait for EyePick to hold for a moment before lowering, and wait for Gripped before lifting. Stop the outfeed belt while the box is put down.

faultCases: The starter drives no output, so nothing moves; write the transfer: feed one box at a time, grip, carry and release each one over the outfeed, and light Done after the fourth.
